newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Sudanese for killing Saudi man.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Sudanese for killing Saudi man.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Sudanese man for stabbing a Saudi national to death after a brawl, Saudi state-run television said.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the television said the victim died after being stabbed once in his chest.
The beheading, in the capital Riyadh, raised to 68 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
